paragraphs.text: Tavver was an Oriq cultist on Arcavios .

Tavver was resourceful and loyal to Extus Narr . Tavver blended into the shadows, capable of navigating covertly through difficult situations. He was cautious and calculated, always weighing the risks in a world full of powerful mages and dangerous missions. Tavver was pragmatic and aware of his limitations. He knew the dangers of his missions and the potential consequences of failure. Despite his reservations, he remained loyal to Extus, even when faced with daunting challenges and potential betrayals.

Tavver found himself trapped underground beneath the Biblioplex after a failed mission. He waited in hiding until nightfall, knowing the dangers of moving during the day in a school full of powerful mages. Tavver's mission had not gone well; he had faced the wrath of a professor and narrowly escaped death. Determined to survive, he embarked on a perilous journey home through the forest, aware of the risks lurking in every shadow.

In the shadows beneath the Biblioplex, Extus Narr faced a threat from a wounded Silverquill student. In a cold and calculated move, he used Tavver as a shield to protect himself. Tavver caught off guard, took the full force of the student's attack meant for Extus. The spell struck him fatally, leaving him lifeless on the ground. Extus swiftly retaliated against the student, ending her threat with his magic. Tavver's sacrifice became a grim testament to Extus's ruthless pursuit of power and his disregard for those who served him.
